# Langfuse

Skills that teach agents to work with Langfuse. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [langfuse/skills](https://github.com/langfuse/skills), at commit `b86532b`.

Work with Langfuse tracing, prompts and evaluation, and migrate prompts to Langfuse.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Langfuse**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Langfuse**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install langfuse@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

2 skills: `langfuse`, `migrate-to-langfuse`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for using Langfuse and its documentation.
